name: Business Health Check
title: Business Health Check: Free Financial Score for Your Business
description: Score your business out of 100 on profit margin, liquidity, debt, collections and growth using simple, transparent rules of thumb. Free.
lead: Enter a few figures from your accounts to get a quick score and see exactly how each point was earned.
intro: This is a quick self-check, not a credit rating. It looks at up to five measures and gives each 0, 1 or 2 points using the bands shown in the table.

The score is the points you earned as a share of the points possible for the measures you filled in. You need at least three measures. Industries differ, so use it as a prompt to ask questions. Nothing is uploaded.
how: Net profit margin = net profit / revenue.
Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities.
Debt to equity = borrowings / owners' equity.
Days to collect = receivables / revenue x 365.
Revenue growth = (this year - last year) / last year.
Score = points earned / points possible x 100. Strong is 80 or more, Mixed is 50 to 79, below 50 needs attention.
example: Revenue 10,000,000, net profit 1,200,000 (12%, 2 points), current ratio 1.6 (2), debt to equity 1.5 (1). Points 5 of 6 gives a score of 83, Strong.
mistakes: Reading a low score as a verdict without checking your industry.
